title: Pour it into cout
prompt:
Ciel already wrote the boring parts: the #include line and main.

In C++, std::cout is the console, and << sends text into it. Add one line inside main so the program prints exactly:

Hello, world!
hints: Write std::cout, then <<, then the text in double quotes. End the line with a semicolon.
Inside main, add: std::cout << "Hello, world!" << std::endl;
